description: Westover Square is a strategically positioned shopping destination located at 8739 TX-151 in San Antonio, Texas, offering prime access along the major east-west highway arterial of Highway 151 near I-410. This property serves as a convenient hub for both local residents and tourists visiting nearby Sea World, one of Texas's top tourist destinations. The center benefits from its location in a growing corridor that includes the Comfort Suites Hotel, Willie's Grill & Icehouse, Grand Tequila Mexican Restaurant, and the Mays Family YMCA at Potranco, creating a vibrant mixed-use environment. The trade area demonstrates strong demographics with nearly 20,000 residents within one mile and a median household income of $75,563, supported by a robust daytime population of over 17,000 workers in the immediate vicinity. Currently listed as a disposition property by Kimco Realty, Westover Square represents an established retail location in one of San Antonio's key growth corridors, offering excellent visibility and accessibility for businesses seeking to serve both the local community and the substantial tourist traffic drawn to the area's attractions.
